svg.aria-label: The citation-check mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Citation compliance: each claim against its source's full text (agent); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the cited entries follow another style than the Citation Format row (stop); A claim the run cannot support (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict (stop); Citation report (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
